{{Top|leg}}
A '''fragmentation mine''' was an explosive device designed to send blasts of shrapnel through any nearby enemies. After being set, the [[Mine/Legends|mine]] had a specific distance radius, that when disturbed, would trigger the mine. With the appropriate skills, it was possible to avoid, disable or recover this mine.
